title: America First Seafood Strategy Charts Course to Restoring U.S. Seafood Dominance
source_name: Office of the U.S. Trade Representative
excerpt: America First Seafood Strategy Charts Course to Restoring U.S. Seafood Dominance myarbrough Wed, 10/28/2026 - 09:39 WASHINGTON – In honor of National Seafood Month, the White House unveiled the historic America First Seafood Strategy , outlining a whole-of-government approach to revitalize the U.S. fishing industry by removing foreign trade barriers and unlocking new markets for U.S. fishermen. Under President Trump’s leadership, U.S. seafood exports reached $5.53 billion in 2025, increasing 12% compared to 2024, and many of our trading partners have committed to remove trade barriers that undercut our global competitiveness. U.S. seafood exports are continuing to trend upwards in 2026. REELING IN THE WINS: The Trump Administration continues to secure new and enforce existing commitments from key trading partners to combat illegal, unreported, and unregulated (IUU) fishing, prevent forced labor on the high seas, and address harmful fisheries subsidies and other practices that distort markets and decimate the U.S. seafood industry. title: USTR Announces 2026 Award Recipients
source_name: Office of the U.S. Trade Representative
excerpt: USTR Announces 2026 Award Recipients pbrouillette Wed, 10/21/2026 - 19:05 WASHINGTON — Today, the Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) hosted its annual awards ceremony, celebrating the achievements and notable milestones of its staff. During the program, award recipients were announced in the following categories: Ambassador’s Award, William B. Kelly Award, Linda Enoch Award, Excellence in Service Award, Erland Herfindahl Award, Superior Achievement Award, Distinguished Career Service Award, Team Award, Way to Go Award, and Length of Service Award. “Through their unwavering commitment to public service and pursuit of excellence, the USTR team has helped advance and execute President Trump’s America First Trade Policy, delivering lasting benefits for American farmers, manufacturers, workers, and businesses of all sizes,” said Ambassador Jamieson Greer . “Our team embodies the true meaning of public service, leading with integrity and professionalism. title: Ambassador Greer Highlights the Success of President Trump’s Trade Program in Fueling America’s Industrial Resurgence While Touring Utah Plants
source_name: Office of the U.S. Trade Representative
excerpt: Ambassador Greer Highlights the Success of President Trump’s Trade Program in Fueling America’s Industrial Resurgence While Touring Utah Plants myarbrough Mon, 10/19/2026 - 16:43 WASHINGTON – Last week, Ambassador Jamieson Greer met with blue-collar workers and toured advanced manufacturing facilities, spanning from the nation’s largest ski manufacturer to a new semiconductor fabrication plant in development. Back at his alma mater, Ambassador Greer met with students and faculty at Brigham Young University (BYU) to discuss how President Trump’s trade policy is rebalancing global trade to secure lasting benefits for Americans today and the generations to follow. At the G20 Interfaith Forum, Ambassador Greer joined a panel discussion on how governments and faith leaders should work together to support economic policies that help families, communities, and entire nations thrive. Read his full remarks here .
